summary.headline: Las Vegas trip, 15–22 Feb 2027: the research is mostly done, but no prices are verified yet
bullets: Trip window: 15 Feb–23 Mar 2027. Preferred: Mon 15 Feb to Thu 18 Feb 2027 (3 nights). 15 Feb 2027 is Presidents' Day (3rd Monday of February).

Michelin Las Vegas, 2026 (official MICHELIN Guide release): 4 starred restaurants (Restaurant de Joël Robuchon 2 stars; L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon, Guy Savoy Las Vegas, é by José Andrés 1 star each), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended (not starred). 24 total.

Michelin density by hotel (on the same resort property, official addresses): The Venetian campus 4, MGM Grand 2, The Cosmopolitan 2, then 1 each at Caesars Palace, Bellagio, Wynn, ARIA and Resorts World.

Hotels: 9 rows (8 properties; The Venetian and Palazzo share one resort) checked for queen beds and private bathroom on official or booking pages. Every price field is blank and flagged as unverified. No 7-night total or cheapest booking date can be stated yet.
Activities: 3 verified attractions with official hours or fees: Red Rock Canyon NCA, Valley of Fire State Park, and Hoover Dam.
Booking timing confirmed so far: é by José Andrés releases tickets 3 months ahead (official site). For a 15 Feb visit that is about mid-November 2026, so check now.
Social links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram): none verified yet. The table columns are in place but empty.
Transit: Las Vegas has no subway. The brief's 1-hour subway/bus radius needs an RTC bus or monorail check, which is not done yet.

questions.q: Is the trip 3 nights (Presidents' Day weekend, 15–18 Feb) or 7 nights (15–22 Feb)?
questions.known: The brief asks for both: preferred 15–18 Feb, and a 7-night cost comparison.
questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the user. Both options are priced on the same basis once the choice is made.

questions.q: What is the 7-night total price for each candidate hotel?
questions.known: No official published rate for these dates was found.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check each hotel's official booking site for 15–22 Feb 2027 once bookable. Record the rate, date, and taxes/resort fees as shown.

questions.q: When is the cheapest time to book?
questions.known: Not verified. Most starred-restaurant tables release 30–60 days ahead (Visit Las Vegas, a tourism site); é releases tickets 3 months ahead (official site).
questions.answer_needed: Booking-window data for each hotel and restaurant.
questions.how_to_resolve: Track rates on official sites weekly from now to February. Record the date each rate is first shown.

questions.q: Which hotel rooms have a private bathroom and a queen bed or larger for two adults?
questions.known: Confirmed for 8 of 9 hotel rows from official or booking pages. Several sizes and the MGM Grand bathroom are not confirmed.
questions.answer_needed: Room number, bed type, bathroom, and size confirmed on the official room page.
questions.how_to_resolve: Open each official room page and screenshot the bed and bath line. Replace any third-party value.

questions.q: Which restaurants are open on which days in February 2027, and at what hours?
questions.known: Only é by José Andrés has official hours. Other restaurants are blank.
questions.answer_needed: Official hours and exceptions for each restaurant.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check each restaurant's official site or the Michelin Guide listing (guide.michelin.com was not reachable in this session).

questions.q: What does a couple of 2 adults pay per restaurant?
questions.known: No verified price for any restaurant.
questions.answer_needed: Price range or exact menu price for 2 adults.
questions.how_to_resolve: Use each restaurant's official menu page. Record the menu name, per-person price, and the total for 2 adults.

questions.q: How long is the travel time from each hotel to each restaurant and activity by bus or monorail?
questions.known: Addresses are verified. Travel times are not.
questions.answer_needed: Verified transit times for each hotel-to-restaurant pair.
questions.how_to_resolve: Use the RTC (Regional Transportation Commission) trip planner and the Las Vegas Monorail site. Record time and route.

questions.q: Are the Feb 15 2027 Presidents' Day fee waivers in effect at Red Rock Canyon?
questions.known: The BLM waived amenity fees on Presidents' Day in 2021. A 2027 waiver is not confirmed.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check blm.gov and recreation.gov closer to the date.

questions.q: Which activities does the couple want to do?
questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the user. Add verified options to the activities table once the list is set.

questions.q: What is the current verified social media link for each restaurant and attraction?
questions.answer_needed: Official-site or official-account links for YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check each official site footer for linked social accounts. Mark any account not linked from an official site as unverified.

suggestions.title: Choose the trip length first
suggestions.detail: Pick 3 nights (15–18 Feb) or 7 nights (15–22 Feb). This decides which hotel totals to collect.
suggestions.impact: High — every cost row depends on it.

suggestions.title: Collect hotel rates by a fixed schedule
suggestions.detail: Record official-site rates for the 9 hotel rows once booking opens. Log the date, the total, and taxes/fees for each. Re-check weekly.
suggestions.impact: High — fills all blank price cells and shows the cheapest booking date.

suggestions.title: Verify restaurant hours and menu prices from official sites
suggestions.detail: Add the restaurant's official site to each Michelin row. Record hours, closed days, and a menu price for 2 adults.
suggestions.impact: High — the brief asks for this for every restaurant.

suggestions.title: Shortlist activities with the couple
suggestions.detail: Ask which activities they want. Verify official hours and fees for each shortlisted attraction (3 are done).

suggestions.title: Add a transit-time check
suggestions.detail: Use the RTC trip planner for each hotel-to-restaurant pair within the 1-hour limit. Record the time shown and the route. Replace the 'subway' wording with bus and monorail.
suggestions.impact: Medium — the 1-hour rule depends on it.

suggestions.title: Add a last-verified date to every row
suggestions.detail: Show the date each value was last checked against its official source. This makes stale values easy to spot.

suggestions.title: Add a comparison score for each hotel
suggestions.detail: Score hotels on Michelin count, room fit, price, and transit time, using weights the user sets. Show the score on the hotels page.
